action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Input validation
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float, not bool")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    
    n_candidates = logp_with_result.shape[0]
    future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    if logp_call_only.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon) or logp_no_call.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
    
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum == 0:
        raise ValueError("Zero weight sum; ensure future_horizon > 0")
    norm_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum
    
    # Weighted future-token loss
    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
    L_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)
    
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    
    # Margin and keep condition
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    
    return keep, margin
